Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.taskscheduler

Class ScheduledTask

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.taskscheduler.ScheduledTask
public final class ScheduledTask extends Object
One user-defined scheduled job: what to run, when to run it (a Trigger), and how the scheduler should behave around it (timeout, concurrency guard, misfire policy, retries). This is the persistent unit the TaskStore saves and the TaskSchedulerEngine fires, and the model the scheduler UI edits.

A task runs either an external ScheduledTask.Action.COMMAND - an argv vector executed directly with ProcessBuilder, never through a shell, so an argument can never be re-interpreted as a shell metacharacter - or a start-menu ScheduledTask.Action.APP, launched in-JVM exactly as clicking the menu item would. The argv list and the environment map are held as structured data rather than a single command string, which is what keeps execution injection-safe.

The class is a mutable bean (the UI edits fields in place and the engine updates the run-state fields after each execution); individual field updates are published through the TaskStore under the engine's lock.
